name: Card2Crypto Global Payment Gateway
author: cyberhunter1880

sections.description:
Card2Crypto is a completely free WooCommerce on-ramp payment gateway that converts fiat money into cryptocurrency for high-risk merchants. With Card2Crypto Instant Checkout, you can start accepting domestic and international credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA, and local bank transfers directly into your USDC Polygon wallet instantly, with 100% chargeback protection.

The Card to Crypto merchant payment gateway does not require any prepaid monthly plan, setup fee, or registration fee. We are revolutionising the payment gateway industry with Web3 and Polygon blockchain technology.

Features

  • Completely free to install with no prepaid monthly plan, setup fee, or registration fee.
  • Directly start accepting credit and debit card payments from your WooCommerce checkout.
  • Accept Apple Pay, Google Pay, SEPA, and local bank transfers through multiple on-ramp payment routes.
  • Instant settlement to your own USDC Polygon wallet with automatic WooCommerce order processing after payment.
  • High-risk merchant payment gateway flow designed for card-to-crypto settlement and strong chargeback protection.
  • Smart hosted checkout with multi-provider routing for stronger approval coverage by customer region.
  • No signup or KYB onboarding required before you start accepting payments.
  • New temporary wallet for each order for privacy, payout tracking, and precise payment matching.
  • Automatic order processing so paid orders can move forward in WooCommerce without manual confirmation.
  • Shared payout wallet and shared custom domain support across enabled direct providers.
  • Customizable checkout titles, descriptions, and logos for hosted and direct provider payment routes.
  • Multi-currency WooCommerce support with instant checkout conversion where required.
  • Manage direct providers, fallback routing, and payout settings from one Card2Crypto dashboard in wp-admin.

Minimum allowed order amount varies per payment provider you can check the full list of minimum order value per payment provider.

The plugin and offered service through Card2Crypto.org Instant Payment Gateway API is subject to the service terms and Privacy Policy. For legal information.
sections.installation:
• After installing and activating this plugin go to WooCommerce >>> Settings >>> Payments >>> Card2Crypto Global Payment Gateway and click Manage.
  • Enter your USDC (Polygon) wallet address in the Card2Crypto dashboard and enable Smart Card2Crypto Hosted.
  • Optionally enable direct providers, customize the checkout labels, and add your own checkout or hosted logos.
  • Save settings and you will be ready to accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and local payment methods instantly.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 3.8 or greater
  • PHP version 5.2.4 or greater
sections.faq:
Do I need to sign up as a merchant to use the plugin?

No, the plugin is available to be used to accept credit card payments instantly without sign up because it depends on the fiat to crypto onramp providers.

What type of payment gateway is Card2Crypto?

Card2Crypto works as a fiat to crypto payment gateway, an onramp payment gateway, and a card to crypto merchant gateway for WooCommerce stores that want direct wallet settlement.

When will I receive payouts?

You will receive payouts instantly to your USDC wallet with every order.

How to fix There Are No Payment Methods Available Error?

Follow the guide to Fix WooCommerce There Are No Payment Methods Available Error

I have a problem with one of my orders?

Please contact Card2Crypto.org support team to guide you.

I’m receiving payments to my wallet but orders are still pending payment?

Our plugin is tested to mark orders as processing automatically after payment. You can follow our guide for fixing common payment gateway issues.

Are there any restricted businesses?

Anyone can use our payment plugin instantly without providing any information. However if your website category falls under our prohibited business list your domain will be blocked.
sections.changelog:
8.2

  • Published the unified Card2Crypto card, bank, and non-custodial cryptocurrency payment suite as version 8.2.
  • Refreshed the WordPress.org screenshot gallery to document the current dashboard and payment controls.

2.0.0

  • Added an on-site, non-custodial cryptocurrency checkout alongside Card2Crypto card and bank payment routes.
  • Added searchable coin and blockchain controls with separate payout wallets for supported networks.
  • Unified card, bank, cryptocurrency, checkout customization, and payment-status settings in one responsive dashboard.
  • Preserved standalone cryptocurrency gateway settings and runtime compatibility to prevent duplicate gateways during migration.
  • Added secure autosave, improved mobile checkout behavior, and refined custom-domain guidance.

1.93.4

  • Fixed checkout icons escaping the payment-method row when themes apply floats, negative margins, or custom image positioning.
  • Prevented Card2Crypto payment rows from creating horizontal scrolling on mobile checkout and order-pay pages.
  • Cache-busted the checkout stylesheet so existing sites receive the corrected responsive rules immediately after updating.

1.93.3

  • Fixed WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks integration so storefronts no longer load WooCommerce editor preview cart data such as Beanie and Cap sample products.
  • Registered Card2Crypto gateways through WooCommerce’s block payment method registry so checkout blocks can submit the selected payment method without loading editor-only dependencies.

1.93.2

  • Fixed Smart Card2Crypto Hosted payment links by preserving the wallet token returned by the Card2Crypto API, preventing invalid hosted and downstream provider checkout URLs.
  • Kept the hosted redirect filter flow compatible while switching the final handoff away from double-encoding.

1.93.1

  • Fixed Smart Card2Crypto Hosted custom checkout title and description so saved provider-manager copy now shows correctly during checkout.
  • Fixed hosted provider defaults from being reset back over saved checkout copy.
  • Improved checkout icon rendering and sizing so provider logos follow WooCommerce’s native gateway icon path more reliably.

1.93

  • Increased checkout logo sizing and kept provider icons closer to the payment titles for a cleaner row layout.
  • Added per-provider checkout icon visibility controls in the Card2Crypto dashboard.
  • Refreshed the WordPress admin and readme descriptions for the 1.93 release package.
